semiconductor_relevance: High — Tokyo Dylec specializes in particle measurement solutions critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes, particularly at the single-nano level.
summary: Tokyo Dylec provides advanced measurement equipment designed to tackle particle contamination challenges in semiconductor manufacturing. Their product lineup includes solutions for measuring single-nano-sized particles, which are essential for maintaining the integrity of cutting-edge semiconductor processes.
capabilities: SMPS series for measuring particle size and classification of single-nano particles
VSP-G1 desktop metal nanoparticle generator for producing nanoparticles
VSP-P1 nanoparticle printer for automatic deposition of porous nanostructures
